sloka: तैल द्रोण्याम् अथ अमात्याः सम्वेश्य जगती पतिम् ।राज्ञः सर्वाणि अथ आदिष्टाः चक्रुः कर्माणि अनन्तरम् ॥२-६६-१४॥
transliteration: taila droṇyām atha amātyāḥ samveśya jagatī patim ।rājñaḥ sarvāṇi atha ādiṣṭāḥ cakruḥ karmāṇi anantaram ॥2-66-14॥

translations.english: The counsellors, instructed (by Vasistha and others), placed the king's body in an oil tub with the understanding that the funeral rites were to be performed hereafter.
